name: Medchal Diagnostic Center
subject: Built this after watching my father run a diagnostic centre
body:
Hello Medchal Diagnostic Center team,

My father runs a diagnostic centre here in Hyderabad. For years I watched him stay back late over paper registers, writing reports by hand and chasing patients to collect them. So I built HealthFlow to fix exactly that, for centres like Medchal Diagnostic Center.

HealthFlow runs your billing and your lab reports, with age and gender reference ranges built in, then sends the bill and the report to the patient on WhatsApp automatically. All under your own name and letterhead, with a QR the patient can scan to verify. It is the system I wish my father had.

It starts at just 399 rupees a month. Most centres are quoted 8,000 or more for something similar. I am giving the first centres a 15 day free trial, no card and no setup fee, because I would rather earn your trust than your setup fee.

You can see the whole thing at healthflow.in. Could I show you a 2 minute demo this week, or set it up on your own data so you can try it live?

Thanks,
Saipranav
HealthFlow, Hyderabad
healthflow.in
